limits_policy.file_lines: Retired 2026-07-27 by owner decision, recorded in docs/dev/plans/15-concept-axis-layout-and-module-consolidation-plan.md (P2). There is no maximum Python file length. The retired limit (hard 2000, recommended 1200) encoded 'a person cannot hold more than N lines in their head at once', and this codebase is now read primarily by agents. This is a deliberate policy amendment, not a budget weakened to make a change pass, and the three file_exemptions it waived were removed with it.
limits_policy.function_complexity: Mandatory. The retirement argument above is about file SIZE only. Complexity is about testability and defect density, not reading capacity, so agent-assisted reading does not weaken it.
limits_policy.native_file_lines: Mandatory and unchanged. The Python retirement does not apply to native translation units.
